name: GhostScrollArea
description: Headless native overflow container. useGhostScrollArea owns overflow measurement, tabindex policy, and keyboard scrolling; GhostScrollArea is the scroll root with a default slot. Themed recipes live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: as
props.description: Scroll root host. Closed union; only div is supported initially.

props.name: label
props.description: Maps to aria-label when the root is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axes may scroll when content exceeds the box.

props.name: type
props.description: Native overflow mode on enabled axes: auto or scroll.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Scrollable content inside the native overflow root.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Native overflow host. data-orientation configures axes; data-overflow reflects measured overflow (none, vertical, horizontal, both).

keyboard.ArrowDown: Scrolls down when the root is focused and vertical overflow is enabled.
keyboard.ArrowUp: Scrolls up when the root is focused and vertical overflow is enabled.
keyboard.ArrowLeft: Scrolls toward inline start when horizontal overflow is enabled.
keyboard.ArrowRight: Scrolls toward inline end when horizontal overflow is enabled.
keyboard.Space: Prevented default on the focused root to avoid page scroll.
